verdict.rationale: Adyen documents that in-person payments run on its own PCI PTS 6 certified, PCI-compliant terminals that handle shopper interactions through the Terminal API, which supports the core idea that certified vendor hardware captures card data. The evidence does not show that card data is encrypted end-to-end away from merchant systems, does not state that integrators' PCI scope is reduced, and contains no vendor guidance on what compliance obligations remain. missing for 10: explicit end-to-end/point-to-point encryption documentation, statement of PCI scope reduction for integrators, vendor guidance on remaining PCI obligations (e.g., SAQ type), independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my PCI scope minimal because card data is captured end-to-end by certified readers and vendor systems, with vendor guidance on my remaining obligations

citations.quote: Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.
Lets you choose from a wide range of fully-certified and PCI-compliant Adyen payment terminals.
The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
